import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../../', import.meta.url));
const base = 'f42ab429e74c25760c2d563d939af7f4b9b6f406';
const text = readFileSync(new URL('skills/README.md', new URL('../../../../', import.meta.url)), 'utf8');
const original = execFileSync('git', ['show', `${base}:skills/README.md`], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' });

function humanReview() {
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  const headings = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    const atx = /^(#{1,6})[\t ]+Human review(?:[\t ]+#+)?[\t ]*$/i.exec(lines[i]);
    if (atx) headings.push({ start: i, body: i + 1, level: atx[1].length });
    if (/^Human review[\t ]*$/i.test(lines[i]) && /^[\t ]*(?:=+|-+)[\t ]*$/.test(lines[i + 1] ?? '')) {
      headings.push({ start: i, body: i + 2, level: lines[i + 1].trim().startsWith('=') ? 1 : 2 });
    }
  }
  assert.equal(headings.length, 1, 'Expected one Markdown section headed Human review');
  const heading = headings[0];
  let end = lines.length;
  for (let i = heading.body; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
    const atx = /^(#{1,6})[\t ]+/.exec(lines[i]);
    const setext = lines[i].trim() && /^[\t ]*(?:=+|-+)[\t ]*$/.test(lines[i + 1] ?? '');
    if ((atx && atx[1].length <= heading.level) || (setext && (lines[i + 1].trim().startsWith('=') ? 1 : 2) <= heading.level)) {
      end = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  return lines.slice(heading.body, end).join('\n');
}

test('A1: README exposes a nonempty Human review section', () => {
  assert.ok(humanReview().trim().length > 0, 'Human review must contain explanatory text');
});

test('A5: Human review includes a Markdown link to the owner guide', () => {
  const section = humanReview();
  const inline = /\[[^\]\n]+\]\(\s*<?\.\.\/docs\/operations\/human-review\.md>?(?:\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\([^)]*\)))?\s*\)/;
  const definitions = [...text.matchAll(/^ {0,3}\[([^\]]+)\]:\s*<?\.\.\/docs\/operations\/human-review\.md>?(?:\s+.*)?$/gm)];
  const referenced = definitions.some((match) => {
    const label = match[1].trim().toLowerCase();
    return [...section.matchAll(/\[([^\]\n]+)\](?:\[([^\]\n]*)\])?/g)].some((ref) => (ref[2] || ref[1]).trim().toLowerCase() === label);
  });
  assert.ok(inline.test(section) || referenced, 'Owner guide must be linked from Human review using the specified relative Markdown target');
});

test('A6: provenance/license table remains byte-for-byte intact', () => {
  const table = original.match(/^\| Skill \| Upstream \| License \| `SOURCE\.md` \|\r?\n(?:\|[^\n]*(?:\n|$))+/m);
  assert.ok(table, 'Trusted base must contain the provenance table');
  assert.ok(text.includes(table[0].trimEnd()), 'Preserve the entire existing table, including every entry and link');
});

test('Compatibility: existing stage and bundle descriptions remain intact and ordered', () => {
  const paragraphs = original.split(/\r?\n\s*\r?\n/).filter((paragraph) => paragraph.trim() && !paragraph.startsWith('|'));
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const paragraph of paragraphs) {
    const index = text.indexOf(paragraph.trimEnd(), cursor);
    assert.ok(index >= cursor, `Existing description removed, changed, or reordered: ${paragraph}`);
    cursor = index + paragraph.trimEnd().length;
  }
});
